Company

SIGIL SARL

SIGIL SARL — Sovereign Integrity Governance Infrastructure Labs — is a Cameroonian company based in Buea, building sovereign governance infrastructure for public institutions.

What is SIGIL?

SIGIL SARL (Sovereign Integrity Governance Infrastructure Labs) is a Cameroonian company, founded in 2023 and based in Buea, that builds sovereign governance infrastructure for public institutions: systems where the institution holds the keys, the data stays under the institution’s control, and every consequential action is authorized, bounded, and proven.

  • Founded in 2023, based in Buea, Cameroon.
  • Registered in Cameroon — RCCM RC.BUA.2026.B.0190.
  • Three systems: VIGIL, RÉCOR, and APEX — all pre-deployment.
  • Founder and Managing Director: Junior Thuram Nana.

SIGIL SARL is a governance-infrastructure company in Cameroon. It is not related to the Sigil ebook editor, the common noun sigil (a magical seal), the “Sovereign Sigil” item in the video game Elden Ring Nightreign, or any other organisation named Sigil.

Frequently asked

What is SIGIL?

Is SIGIL a GovTech company?

Yes. SIGIL SARL is a Cameroonian GovTech and RegTech company: it builds technology for public institutions — governed cybersecurity (VIGIL), beneficial-ownership registry technology (RÉCOR), and procurement-integrity intelligence (APEX) — from Buea, Cameroon.

Where is SIGIL based?

SIGIL SARL is based in Buea, Cameroon.

What does SIGIL build?

SIGIL builds three systems for public institutions: VIGIL, a governed cybersecurity and evidence platform; RÉCOR, a sovereign beneficial-ownership registry; and APEX, an anti-corruption intelligence platform for public procurement. All three are pre-deployment and their source code is kept strictly private.

Who founded SIGIL?

SIGIL SARL was founded in 2023 by Junior Thuram Nana, its Founder and Managing Director.

Who we are

SIGIL SARL is registered in Cameroon (RCCM RC.BUA.2026.B.0190) and based in Buea. It designs and builds a small number of systems for public institutions — today, VIGIL, RÉCOR, and APEX — each intended to run on the institution's own infrastructure, under the institution's own control.

Leadership

Junior Thuram Nana is the Founder & Managing Director of SIGIL SARL. Other members of the team are not named publicly.

How the work holds together

Because we do not present a roster, it is fair to ask how the work stays dependable. The answer is method, not headcount. The same doctrine we apply to the systems governs how we build them:

Signed authority

Consequential actions in our own tooling are signed and attributable, so decisions have provenance.

Roles and separation

Access follows least privilege and role separation; unknown permissions are denied by default.

Written procedure

Build, release, key management, backup, and incident response are documented procedures, not tacit knowledge.

Reproducible builds

Releases are signed and shipped with a software bill of materials, so what runs can be checked against what was shipped.

Recoverable custody

Key custody uses escrow and threshold recovery, so no single point is unrecoverable.

How we work with institutions

We prefer to work in the open with the relevant authorities rather than develop a unilateral interpretation of our obligations. The goal is technology that is developed locally, auditable, and operable within a clearly defined authorization framework — so that the institution, not the vendor, remains in control.
